LESSON: WRITING 5.4.1 CREATIVE WRITING NARRATIVE COMPOSITIONS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.4: Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing Narrative Compositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing Narrative Compositions, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Why do you enjoy reading and sign reading stories? 2. How do you make your composition interesting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing Narrative Compositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: Exploration as learners read and sign read samples of narrative compositions

• Learning to learn: Learning Independently as learners individually compose a narrative of (120 -160 words) .

Values:
Unity: Cooperation as learners, In groups, brainstorm ideas for a narrative composition.

Link to other Subjects:

The learners are able to link the knowledge on traditional food crops taught in writing to similar concepts in Science and Technology.
